attested in context

  • CURIE: gmeow:attestedInContext
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedInContext
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/lexicon

The corpus, platform, community, dataset, inscription, or broader context in which the attested form was observed. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a form may be attested in multiple contexts simultaneously, and context assignments are standpoint-scoped.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:UsageAttestation -> gmeow:Entity

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:attestedInContext from gmeow:UsageAttestation to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:UsageAttestation, gmeow:Entity
